archive: v0.7 validation, regression and development evidence
interpretation: Frozen formal experiments and pre-freeze test runs are reported separately.
The test logs contain results and timing, but no execution source digest. No test execution commit/hash is invented from later freezes.
Legacy M2, M3 and M3F keep their separate 14, 10 and 8 check denominators; rerunning these after the second freeze is not additional independent coverage.
The CLI exercise is a development run explicitly recorded dirty; it is not relabeled as a clean formal run even though its source digest matches the final freeze.

test_runs.identity_limitation: Run before the corresponding freeze; the retained test log itself did not record a Git commit, dirty flag or source hash.

explicit_draft_write_permission_defect.attribution: Confirmed during dirty v0.7 stage-B explicit-publication integration, after stage-A freeze. The probe records the exact WorldCore module SHA before and after, but not a clean commit identity. It is separate from the v0.6 F1/F2 authorization defects.
explicit_draft_write_permission_defect.trigger: A world actor has create_object power and becomes the created object writer; the world uses explicit publication, and the actor has no publish power.
explicit_draft_write_permission_defect.observed: Creation succeeded; legitimate draft write was rejected with Actor lacks world power: publish; formal publish was correctly rejected.
explicit_draft_write_permission_defect.cause: WorldCore._save_content retained the old unconditional world publish power check, coupling draft write permission to formal publication permission.
explicit_draft_write_permission_defect.repair: Explicit-policy draft edits use the object writer gate. The legacy implicit-write world policy keeps its additional publish-power condition. No wildcard publish power is granted to the writer.
